claim: Specific RT sequence information improves prediction of the cognate ncRNA beyond broad retron type
scope_limit: Out-of-fold, component-blocked. Predictive improvement only; no mechanism implied.

claim: That improvement replicates the X1 pilot in direction and magnitude
estimate: X1 -0.01778 vs X2 -0.02470; 65.0% vs 64.9% components favour R
scope_limit: Internal replication on the SAME population; not external validation.

claim: The improvement survives the high-independence T4 stratum
scope_limit: DESIGN 3 predicted this might stay UNDETERMINED; prediction was wrong in the favourable direction.

claim: The improvement is not an artefact of near-duplicate sequences
scope_limit: Frozen near-duplicate-excluded sensitivity population.

claim: The improvement is not carried by a single fold
The improvement is robust to optimization seed
scope_limit: Seeds bound optimization variance only; they do not add biological samples.

claim: Specific RT beats a coarse 50%-identity homolog-group representation
scope_limit: Sign stable across 3 seeds; MAGNITUDE NOT DETERMINED (range -0.0055 to -0.0156, sd 0.0051).

claim: Most of the RT-associated gain is explained at the homolog-lineage level
scope_limit: The specific-RT increment beyond lineage is the small remainder.

claim: Observed RT beats a same-retron-type counterfactual
scope_limit: Weakest of the four controls; ~10x easier than C4.

claim: Observed RT beats a length-matched same-type counterfactual
scope_limit: Excludes gross length/truncation artefacts.

claim: Observed RT beats its nearest ESM-C embedding neighbours
scope_limit: Only 52.5% of PAIRS favour observed: near chance at pair level.

claim: Observed RT beats an alternative from its own 50%-identity cluster
scope_limit: Statistically non-zero but ~10x smaller than C1. Significance is not substantive discrimination.

claim: Counterfactual discrimination decays as alternatives become more similar
scope_limit: ~10-fold decay C1 -> C4.

claim: Pair-level discrimination approaches chance under the strongest controls
estimate: 52.5% of pairs favour observed at C3; raw pair-level mean -0.000205 (median +0.000187)
scope_limit: Component-level mean is positive (+0.003974) while the raw PAIR-level mean is nominally negative: a weighting effect, since component-level aggregation gives every independent component equal weight. Forbids any per-pair biological reading.

claim: Some gain comes from conditioning on a realistic RT representation independent of correct pairing
scope_limit: Within-type deranged RTs still beat the type label (~24% of R-T). R-P = -0.01880.

claim: Generalisation varies with relatedness to training RTs
scope_limit: Effect NOT demonstrated in least-similar quartile. R-G is flat across quartiles, localising the gradient to arm T.

claim: The effect is not an artefact of repeated database deposition
estimate: present at all adjudicable n_physical_loci levels; weaker at >=21 (-0.01070)
scope_limit: Also present in recurrence class multiple_species (-0.02507, 364 components).

claim: The effect holds for the largest RT homolog groups (>100 members)
scope_limit: Below the 30-component threshold. NOT a null.

claim: The effect holds for the largest ncRNA clusters (>100 members)
scope_limit: Below threshold; the 21-100 bin also spans zero. NOT a null.

claim: RT and ncRNA are biochemically compatible / bind / physically interact
scope_limit: No biochemical or structural assay exists in this work.

claim: Non-observed RT-ncRNA combinations are incompatible or non-functional
scope_limit: Counterfactuals are conditioning CONTROLS. Absence from the corpus is NON-OBSERVATION.

claim: RT and ncRNA co-evolved / the result demonstrates co-evolution
scope_limit: No phylogenetic or causal analysis was performed.

claim: Retron systems are orthogonal / RTs are functionally interchangeable or not
scope_limit: No functional or interchangeability assay.

claim: The model identifies the cognate RT of an ncRNA at the individual-pair level
scope_limit: Near chance under the strongest controls. No per-pair biological inference is supported.

claim: Retron type explains all, or none, of the observed signal
scope_limit: Signal exists beyond type, AND most of it is lineage-level. Neither extreme holds.

claim: These results constitute external validation
scope_limit: INTERNAL cross-fitted confirmation on the same 30,924-pair population as X1.

claim: Component-weighted and pair-weighted counterfactual aggregates agree in direction at C1/C2/C4 but differ in sign at C3
scope_limit: Weighting effect, not an inconsistency. The component-level estimate is the preregistered endpoint.
